plan.summary: This 4-week block starts the 12-week off-camp parent cycle for boxing with a build-focused strength and power emphasis. Because you only have 1 S&C session per week, each session is full-body and centered on high-value compound work with a small amount of explosive work first. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main percentage-based lift so the main loading can start in Week 2, and Weeks 2-4 build strength steadily while keeping fatigue manageable around boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general strength and simple explosive qualities with clean technique and manageable fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress strength and power with slightly heavier work while keeping recovery in line with boxing load.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Turn the earlier strength work into faster, sharper outputs without forcing a fight-camp speed peak.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use a box height you can land on softly and confidently. Reset between reps and focus on crisp takeoff and quiet landing.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if boxes are busy or if jumping onto a box feels awkward. Jump for height and stick the landing.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want an even simpler option. Start still, jump fast, and land under control.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with small jumps until the weight feels challenging, then work up to one hard top set of 3-5 reps with solid form. Stop if depth or bracing breaks down.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. This establishes your baseline for future percentage work.

substitutionOptions.name: Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if back squat setup is uncomfortable. Keep the same hard top set of 3-5 reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Safety Bar Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if available and it feels more stable. Keep the same hard top set of 3-5 reps.

performanceTarget.prompt: Log your best clean top set with load and reps.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Use a load that leaves about 2 reps in reserve. Keep your feet planted, pause briefly on the chest, and press smoothly.

substitutionOptions.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if benches are busy or if dumbbells feel more stable on the shoulders.

substitutionOptions.name: Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you need a simpler option. Elevate the hands if needed to keep reps clean.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: Use a load that leaves 1-2 reps in reserve. Pull the elbows back, pause briefly at the top, and avoid shrugging.

substitutionOptions.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if the chest-supported row station is taken. Keep the torso stable and avoid twisting.

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Cable Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want a simple machine-based option with steady tension.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Use a moderate load with clean hinge mechanics. Keep the bar close, slight knee bend, and stop before your back position changes.

substitutionOptions.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want a simpler setup. Keep the same hinge pattern and controlled lowering.

substitutionOptions.name: 45-Degree Back Extension
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if hinging with a bar is not comfortable. Hold a plate or dumbbell if bodyweight is too easy.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.notes: Move slowly out, keep the ribs down, and only go as far as you can without losing trunk position.

substitutionOptions.name: Barbell Rollout
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if an ab wheel is not available. Keep the range short enough to stay braced.

substitutionOptions.name: Cable Crunch
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if rollouts are too hard right now. Move with control and keep the hips still.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Every rep should look snappy. Rest enough between sets to keep jump height and landing quality high.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if boxes are unavailable. Jump for height and reset each rep.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want the simplest explosive option. Stay crisp and stop if height drops.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Brace hard, control the descent, and drive up fast. Add a small load next week only if all sets are clean.

substitutionOptions.name: Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if front-loaded squatting feels safer or easier to coach. Match the same set and rep plan.

substitutionOptions.name: Safety Bar Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if available and it keeps you more upright and comfortable. Match the same set and rep plan.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track bar weight and reps so the app can monitor your squat trend.
